description: Sends the user a free personal Spain visa assessment by email, written from the details they give: which visa fits their situation, the 2026 income figure for their household, the document checklist for their own consulate (including how to get their criminal record certificate apostilled), a realistic timeline from My Spain Visa's own case data for that consulate, and the usual refusal risks for that route. It is put together automatically from the user's answers and the firm's published figures and case data, and signed by Lucia, the firm's immigration lawyer, who reads and answers replies by email. Offer it once when the user has a concrete case. Requires name, email and explicit consent to be contacted (show the privacy notice first and ask for a clear yes). The user's details go to My Spain Visa's client system so the firm can reply.

consent_to_contact.description: Must be true, and only after the user has been shown this notice: "My Spain Visa (CONSTANTSGROUP S.L.) will use your name, email and the details you share only to send you the assessment and reply about your case. You can withdraw your consent at any time. Privacy policy: https://myspainvisa.com/privacy-policy/" and has explicitly agreed to: "I agree that My Spain Visa may contact me about my case." Never set it on the user's behalf. If the user has not said yes, do not call this tool.

country_of_residence.description: Country where the user legally lives now (decides the consulate).

currently_in_spain_legally.description: True if the user is in Spain now with a legal stay (for example within their 90 Schengen days).

email.description: User's email address. The assessment or reply goes there.

family_members.description: Family members moving with the user (spouse, children), not counting the user.

is_eu_citizen.description: True if the user holds an EU, EEA or Swiss passport.

monthly_income_eur.description: Monthly income in euros (for remote work: gross, before tax).

notes.description: Anything else relevant, in the user's words (max 1,000 characters).

partner_or_family_in_spain.description: If the user is joining a partner or family member who is Spanish, another EU citizen, or a non-EU resident of Spain.

purpose.description: Main reason for moving to Spain.

state_or_region.description: US state (and county if California) or UK county or region, to find the consulate.

name: personal_visa_assessment
title: Free personal visa assessment by email
